text: Euronet Worldwide, Inc.'s Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 says its Money Transfer segment provides global money transfers and currency exchange information 'through Ria Money Transfer, Xe and the Dandelion cross-border real-time payments network'.
short: Ria Money Transfer is part of Euronet Worldwide's Money Transfer segment.

source.name: Euronet Worldwide, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: provides global money transfers and currency exchange information in retail stores, apps, and websites through Ria Money Transfer, Xe and the Dandelion
